Express Transit Mode setup vs zh-Hans listing copy — two different jobs

Teams assume Express Transit capability in Wallet covers storefront language. Transit pass enrollment, PassKit frameworks, and Connect actually separate gate-tap behavior from product-page copy:

  • Express Transit Mode enrollment — eligible transit cards or payment cards, Express Mode toggle under Settings → Wallet & Apple Pay → Express Transit Mode. Controls whether a card can tap through gates without authentication — not App Store language. AppLocale does not perform this.
  • PassKit & transit pass provisioning — issuing transit passes, fare media, and agency backend integration. Listing copy may mention Express Transit riding; building PassKit transit APIs is engineering work, not Connect metadata.
  • Default Express Mode card selection — choosing which transit card or payment card rides in Express Mode when multiple cards exist in Wallet. Product-page copy should describe that user-facing choice; implementing card priority logic is in-app engineering.
  • Power-reserve transit — riding transit when iPhone battery is critically low and the device enters power reserve. Listing copy may mention 低电量乘车 value; the runtime power-reserve behavior is system-level, not Connect metadata.
  • Consumer Apple Pay checkout — in-app Apple Pay buttons and NFC payment sheets where the buyer pays at a store. Separate buyer story from transit gate Express Mode — see Apple Pay checkout listing guide.
  • Tap to Pay on iPhone merchant acceptance — terminal-style contactless acceptance for merchants. Separate from commuter Express Transit — see Tap to Pay on iPhone listing guide.
  • Pricing and Availability → China — makes the app downloadable on the China App Store. Separate from language rows.
  • App Store tab → Chinese (Simplified) localization — independent row for title, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text, screenshots, and caption lines. Empty or English here means China buyers see English fallback regardless of Express Transit features in the binary.

Working Express Transit integration and a localized China listing are both required when you sell on the China storefront — neither replaces the other. AppLocale covers how you describe Express Transit, Express Mode, and 免验证乘车 value on the product page in zh-Hans, not how you enroll transit cards or implement PassKit in code.

Express Transit–specific listing copy — what translates differently

Express Transit & Express Mode & 快捷交通卡

US pages use "Express Transit" or "Express Mode for transit cards." China storefront copy often uses 快捷交通卡 or Express Transit 模式 alongside the product name Express Transit where appropriate on screenshot overlays — especially on gate-tap and turnstile frames under Wallet & Apple Pay.

Ride without authentication & 免验证乘车 / 免密乘车

The core Express Mode value prop — tapping through transit gates without Face ID, Touch ID, or passcode — appears frequently on Express Transit screenshots. Chinese buyers expect 免验证乘车 or 免密乘车 for ride-without-authentication frames — not English badges that hide what the app actually markets to commuters.

Default Express Mode card & 默认快捷模式卡

Settings frames where users pick which transit card or payment card rides in Express Mode use default-card vocabulary. zh-Hans copy should describe that selection path with 默认快捷模式卡 when that matches your English source — without inventing regional transit agency names your listing does not claim.

Power-reserve transit & 低电量乘车

US pages mention riding transit when iPhone battery is critically low. Chinese App Store copy commonly uses 低电量乘车 when your gallery shows power-reserve transit value props — describing commuter resilience, not Low Power Mode settings marketing.

Transit cards & 交通卡

Express Transit works with eligible transit cards and, in supported regions, payment cards in Wallet. Screenshot overlays should use 交通卡 for transit-card frames — distinct from 银行卡 payment-card checkout language on the Apple Pay guide.

FAQ

Does enabling Express Transit Mode auto-fill my China App Store listing?

No. Express Transit Mode toggles, default Express Mode card selection, and power-reserve transit behavior control runtime gate-tap behavior on the device — they do not create or fill a Simplified Chinese localization row. If zh-Hans name, subtitle, keywords, description, or screenshot caption fields are empty or still English, the China storefront falls back to en-US copy.

Which App Store Connect fields does AppLocale rewrite?

Paste-ready Simplified Chinese for listing fields you specify: app name, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text when included, and screenshot overlay or caption lines such as Express Transit, Express Mode, ride without authentication, default Express Mode card, 快捷交通卡, 免验证乘车, 免密乘车, and 低电量乘车 — rewritten from your English originals.

Does AppLocale configure Express Transit Mode or transit agencies?

No. AppLocale rewrites App Store Connect listing metadata and screenshot caption text only. Express Transit enrollment, PassKit integration, transit pass provisioning, and agency fare-account setup are engineering and agency tasks outside AppLocale scope.

How is this different from the Apple Pay, Tap to Pay, Apple Cash, Apple Card, and Wallet pages?

Express Transit listing copy covers Settings → Wallet & Apple Pay → Express Transit Mode — ride public transit without authentication, default Express Mode card, and power-reserve transit on gallery frames. Apple Pay checkout listing copy covers consumer in-app payment. Tap to Pay on iPhone listing copy covers merchant card acceptance. Apple Cash listing copy covers person-to-person transfers. Apple Card listing copy covers credit-card Daily Cash and statements. Apple Wallet listing copy covers the digital wallet home screen. Each surface has a separate guide.

Why do my Express Transit screenshot captions still say Express Mode in English on China?

Screenshot overlay lines and caption fields are per localization in App Store Connect. If you never filled zh-Hans caption fields — or pasted English into the Chinese screenshot set — China buyers see Latin script on frames meant to signal 快捷交通卡, 免验证乘车, or 低电量乘车 value.

快捷交通卡 and 免验证乘车 fit Express Transit and Express Mode marketing. 苹果支付 fits consumer checkout sheets on the Apple Pay guide. 轻触付款 fits merchant Tap to Pay on the merchant guide. AppLocale picks phrasing that matches your English claims and screenshot frames.
